description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 56 - Directing catering persons not to engage in the business without obtaining the Good Manufacturing Practices (G.M.P) Process Certification w.e.f. 01.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains a Direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which establishes a regulatory requirement for businesses engaged in mass catering and outdoor catering to obtain GMP certification. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
